## Summary

Remove amber-generated files from the target repository (reverse of init).

## Usage

```bash
amber clean --target <repo> [--json]
```

## Command Details

```text
Remove amber-generated files from the target repository (reverse of init).

Options:
  --dry-run    Preview which files would be removed without deleting them.

Examples:
  amber clean --target path/to/repo
  amber clean --target path/to/repo --dry-run
```

## Boundaries & Safety

- `--target <path>` selects repository state; it does not provide filesystem containment. Absolute-path writes can escape a worktree without OS sandboxing.
- **Fail-Closed Behavior**: Corrupt governance state or invalid schema parameters immediately halt execution with non-zero exit codes.
